main_body: two-story half-timbered and stone building with tiled hip roof
top_band: tiled roof slope and ridge from row 1 to row 42 (orange/red-brown tiles with yellow ridge highlights at rows 2-3)
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened tiled roof top surface (rows 1-42, plus chimney top ellipse at rows 0-4) sitting above a 2-story vertical front wall (rows 43-107). There is a clear eave shadow beneath the roof (rows 43-49) and beneath the upper floor overhang (rows 77-79), and windows/door are properly recessed.

style.evidence: The candidate is an authentic Beodeul piece (combining the roof/plaster of house-h101_0 and the stone base of house-h112_0-stone) with rich tile scallops, plaster grain, multi-tone stone masonry, and dark material-tinted outlines.
